name: offer

function.name: end_call
function.description: Ends the call. CALL it right after you said goodbye, with no other text.

extraction_schema.name: offer_answer
extraction_schema.description: agreed when the customer says yes to the proposal or names their own amount and/or date; refused when they say no without naming any; else stay.

extraction_schema.name: agreed_amount
extraction_schema.description: The amount the customer names themselves, if any.

extraction_schema.name: agreed_date_words
extraction_schema.description: The customer's own words for the payment day, e.g. 'next Tuesday', if they name one.
